title: Ark of the Covenant claimed kept at Aksum
place_text: Chapel beside Church of St Mary of Zion, Aksum, Tigray, Ethiopia

tellings.quote: we have the we have the Ark of the Covenant here

plain: The Ark of the Covenant, the sacred chest of the Bible, is said to be kept in a chapel beside the Church of St Mary of Zion in Aksum, in northern Ethiopia. The writer Graham Hancock tells Michels that while researching there he was told, "we have the Ark of the Covenant here," and he credits his account to the book The Sign and the Seal. If the claim were true, one of the Bible's most famous lost objects would have survived.
